node.statement: Fix the global W_RF supplied by lem-routef-scalar-header-positivity. For arbitrary root input (n,Q,eta,D,J,Q_C,Phi) and an arbitrary same-datum packet (B,S,Delta_prime,Delta,Upsilon_prime,Upsilon) supplied by lem-routef-factor-map-packet, that packet has the exact serial provenance required by the three telescope lemmas; K is finite, universal, and K >= 1, and 0 <= eta <= eta_K <= rho_fac <= rho_DeltaUpsilon, rho_mult, rho_UpsilonDelta.
